name: 97266 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97266 (Portland) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97266 (Portland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
